da-definitional-ambiguity.notes: Key terms and symbols in 'Type-B Cartan folding realises CPT via symmetric-crystal $\\mathbb{Z}/2$ fixed points' are mathematically defined and unambiguous.

da-definitional-ambiguity.evidence: The italic statement says 'folds into a Type-B Cartan datum B_{floor(n/2)}'. That is exact at the Coxeter/Weyl level, where B = C. At the Cartan-datum level the type depends on parity and convention. For n = 2m the diagram-automorphism fixed-point algebra of sl_{2m} is sp_{2m} (type C_m); B_m is the orbit (dual) algebra. For n = 2m+1 the fixed-point algebra is so_{2m+1} (B_m), but the orbit {alpha_m, alpha_{m+1}} contains adjacent nodes, so iota is not an admissible folding in Lusztig's quantum-group sense, and no folded Cartan datum in that sense exists. The added paragraph scopes itself correctly ('At the level of Coxeter groups'). The statement still says 'Cartan datum', and #8774 now extends it explicitly to odd n. Proposed: 'a Coxeter datum of type B_{floor(n/2)}', or a parity note. Flagged, not fixed (claim-bearing wording). Also: the new heading 'Rank and wall weight' uses 'wall', which the block never defines; the body says 'middle generator'. (The author's own store verdict f580598 raised this independently; it is confirmed here.)
